_about: The Mountain Range (levels 3-25): orcs and hobgoblins of the tunnels who answer each other's war-cry, kobold packs, the hill giant, troll, cave mage and great cave bear as elites, and Grondar the Hill Giant Chieftain in his cave, hurling rocks from the roof and calling his kin.

40050.name: grondar hill giant chieftain
40050.long_desc: Grondar, the Hill Giant Chieftain, sits on a boulder gnawing a whole leg of mutton.
40050.description: Fourteen feet of muscle, hair and bad temper, wrapped in bearskins and hung with the skulls of mountain lions. A club made from a whole pine trunk leans against the cave wall within easy reach.

phases.message: Grondar roars and kicks over his boulder seat: "SMASH!"

abilities.name: Ground Slam
abilities.telegraph: Grondar raises his pine-trunk club high over his head!

abilities.name: Backhand
abilities.telegraph: Grondar swings a huge fist at you!

abilities.name: Boulder Hurl
abilities.telegraph: Grondar heaves a boulder up over his head!
